title: WalletAccount
description: A segregated ledger account inside a wallet (ADR-017). A wallet (one per owner+currency) may hold N accounts, each with its own isolated balance and a purpose. Ledger postings reference account_id; an Application Settlement source and a payment destination MAY be an account_id. PRIMARY is mandatory and unique per wallet. A WalletAccount is financial segregation only — never a person, merchant or consumer. Applications never compute a sub-balance outside the operator.

account_id.description: The segregated ledger account — the unit ledger postings reference (ADR-012). Immutable.

owner_ref.description: The wallet owner. Opaque to the protocol.

purpose.description: Segregation purpose. Exactly one PRIMARY per wallet (mandatory, unique).

reference_type.description: Optional external aggregate kind (e.g. a campaign-id namespace). Opaque to the operator.

reference_id.description: Optional external aggregate reference (e.g. a campaign id). Opaque to the operator.

available_balance_minor.description: Settled, spendable balance in integer minor units. Read from the operator — never computed by an application.

pending_balance_minor.description: Not-yet-settled balance in integer minor units.

_numeric_domain: Integers in a signed or digested BANZA artifact are bounded by the canonicalization in force (BCJ/1: |n| <= 2^53-1, spec/canonicalization.md P2). The bound is declared here so the schema and the canonicalization cannot disagree about what is representable.
